Stock market news | Rupee reversal drags Indian government bonds

On Monday the rupee slipped 0.3%, ending its earlier gains, and Indian government bonds dropped as state auctions offered higher yields.

The weaker rupee and higher bond yields increase dollar demand for corporates and lift inflation worries, especially with Brent crude near $92 per barrel.
